jobs.title: Consultant - Supply Chain Management
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Brussels, Belgium; Hamburg, Germany; Munich, Germany; Paris, France
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
As a consultant in our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP) , you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing, and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. You will gain leading edge operations and consultancy skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching, which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program.

We view the OEP position as the start of a rewarding, challenging and highly flexible career with McKinsey and the Operations practice. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a consultant on multiple client engagements and work with a number of colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. You will acquire the necessary knowledge and expertise to help companies achieve excellence in their operations.

Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. You will follow a curriculum based on operations excellence themes and will receive advanced training in one of six specific areas of operations: manufacturing, product development, purchasing, service operations, supply chain management, or capital excellence.

Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm from associate to partner.

You will be based in one of our European offices as part of our Operations Practice.

Our Operations Practice assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges. Blending strategic thinking with hands-on practicality, our teams of consultants and experts work to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients’ most critical problems.

McKinsey’s Supply Chain Management service line is part of our Operations Practice and helps leading companies in all industries develop and implement future-oriented logistics strategies. We do this by making significant improvements in customer service while reducing invested capital and cost by transforming and optimizing their supply chains from end to end.

Please submit your application in English, including your CV and transcripts (high school, university, etc.), with all relevant grades.

#Operations2026
#EuropeEP
- Master’s degree and exceptional academics required
- Initial experience in supply chain management (e.g., design and implementation of logistics strategy, network design and optimization, transportation, warehouse design and optimization, supply chain planning and management processes, supply chain modeling and optimization)
- Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
- Mobility and enthusiasm for taking on European assignments during the work week
- Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
- Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English and local office language

jobs.title: Knowledge Consultant (m/w/d) –  Insurance
jobs.description:
Nachhaltige Veränderung zu bewirken und langfristige Fähigkeiten bei unseren Klienten aufzubauen, ist keine einfache Aufgabe. Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, das Leistung fordert und anerkennt. Du nimmst anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen an, lernst, wenn du stolperst und hast das Durchhaltevermögen, um neue Weg zu gehen.
Von uns kannst du erwarten, dass wir deine Zielstrebigkeit und deine Neugier bestmöglich unterstützen, indem wir dir die Ressourcen, das Mentoring und die Chancen bieten, die es braucht, damit du dich weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Und zwar schneller als du es je für möglich gehalten hast. Deine Kolleg:innen - auf allen Ebenen - unterstützen dich nicht nur bei der Erarbeitung hervorragender Ergebnisse für unsere Klienten, sondern auch bei deiner persönlichen Entwicklung. Tag für Tag erhältst du Unterstützung, Coaching und wertvolle Erfahrungen, die dein Wachstum fördern.
Was dich bei uns erwartet:
- Kontinuierliches Lernen:  Bei McKinsey erwarten dich viele strukturierte Programme, die dir dabei helfen, dich in allen für dich relevanten Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln. Freu dich auf ein Umfeld, in dem das Feedback klar, umsetzbar und auf deine Entwicklung ausgerichtet ist und in dem du schnell, viel lernst.
- Deine Stimme zählt:  Vom ersten Tag an legen wir Wert auf deine Ideen und Beiträge. Mit deinen innovativen Impulsen und praktischen Lösungenansätzen hast du einen spürbaren Einfluss und unterstützt gleichzeitig die kompromisslose Einhaltung unserer Werte und Richtlinien hinsichtlich Ethik und Integrität. Wir fördern unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn sie sind entscheidend, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
- Globale Gemeinschaft:  Mit Kolleg:innen aus über 65 Ländern und mehr als 100 verschiedenen Nationalitäten fördert die Vielfalt unsere Kreativität und hilft uns, die besten Lösungen für unsere Klienten zu finden. Außerdem hast du die Möglichkeit, von außergewöhnlichen Kolleg:innen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen zu lernen.
- Attraktive Benefits:   Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt (basierend auf deiner Einstiegsposition) bieten wir ein attraktives Leistungspaket, das zum Beispiel umfassende medizinische Leistungen für dich, dein:e Partner:in und Kinder umfasst.
Du arbeitest mit unseren Beratungsteams in Klientenprojekten zusammen und hilfst, Geschäftsmodelle in der langfristigen Transformation des Schadenmanagements im Nichtlebengeschäft aufzubauen.

Dabei leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Analyse, Konzeption und Umsetzung von Transformationsstrategien im Schadenmanagement, entwickelst Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit den Klienten zusammen, um positive und nachhaltige Ergebnisse sicherzustellen. In dieser Funktion sorgst du für den nötigen Überblick, bringst dich aktiv in der Problemlösungsfindung ein und wendest deine Branchen- und Fachkenntnisse über die Versicherungsindustrie erfolgreich an. Dabei begleitest du häufig auch Workshops im Schadenmanagement bei Klienten vor Ort.

Auch an internen Projekten und am Ausbau unserer internen Wissensinfrastruktur beteiligst du dich. Wenn du mehr Erfahrung hast, übernimmst du sowohl eigenständige Projekte als auch Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung jüngerer Kolleg:innen.

In dieser Rolle wirst du dem Panorama Financial Institutions Center (PFIC) angehören. Das PFIC ist Teil der Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Practice und eines der größten Knowledge-Teams weltweit. Es besteht aus etwa 250 Mitgliedern an über 25 Standorten. Der Fokus liegt auf dem Finanzdienstleistungssektor, u.a. Retail Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, Wealth & Asset Management, sowie Versicherungen.

Je nach Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung ist ein Einstieg als Senior Knowledge Consultant oder als Knowledge Specialist möglich.

Benötigte Bewerbungsunterlagen:   Lebenslauf (Englisch) sowie alle relevanten akademischen und Arbeitszeugnisse, beginnend mit dem Abiturzeugnis.
- Du hast dein Studium sehr erfolgreich absolviert - mit einem Masterabschluss oder einem anderen vergleichbaren Universitätsabschluss in einer wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen oder quantitativen Fachrichtung.
- Du verfügst über 1 bis sieben Jahre relevanter Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungsindustrie (idealerweise im Schadenmanagement) entweder bei einem Versicherungsunternehmen oder einem Beratungsunternehmen.
- Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Versicherungskonzepte und Kenntnisse über Finanzprodukte und -dienstleistungen. Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Schadenmanagement von Versicherungen im Nichtlebengeschäft sind von Vorteil.
- Du bringst fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Excel, einschließlich Makros, im Erstellen von Regressionsgleichungen und ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit. Kenntnisse in SQL, SPSS, Tableau oder Alteryx sind von Vorteil.
- Du hast Spaß an komplexen Fragestellungen und einen ausgeprägten Sinn für Zahlen, denkst konzeptionell und gehst den Dingen gern analytisch auf den Grund.
- Du bist ein Teamplayer und löst Herausforderungen kollaborativ über alle Ebenen der Organisation.
- Du bringst komplexe Ideen überzeugend auf den Punkt und kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch.

- Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and the local office language(s)

You will implement transformation projects across sectors, ensuring long-term impact delivery.

In this role, you will manage workstreams largely independently, with support of a Delivery or Engagement Manager working with McKinsey colleagues and client teams. As you gain experience, you will gradually assume responsibility for delivering parts of a project.

You will lead junior consultants and clients in your project or workstream and successfully hold client meetings and workshops to achieve the project's objectives. You will grow in a stimulating and human environment where quality of life at work is important.

For more information, visit our website .

You’ll be based in our office in Bucharest as part of Orphoz Central Europe, where our mission is to carry out large-scale transformation projects for our clients.

With only 1/3 of transformations being successful and sustainable, you will help to change this. At Orphoz, we aspire to help our clients to achieve one of their biggest challenges: making their transformation plans really happen. Our day-to-day work is to support large companies who need to adapt their operating models to the accelerated changes of their environment, by combining agility, sustainable efficiency, and employee engagement.

You can expect a uniquely varied and exciting working environment, as well as the opportunity to work with a talented and growing team. Our work will give you access to multiple levels of our clients' organizations, from the field to the management committees, while supporting them on the projects that are at the heart of their strategic agenda.

From day 1, you will enter an accelerated development path thanks to real support and coaching from your peers and directors, who care about frequent interactions and true proximity. Moreover, coaching, mentoring and regular feedback are key in our culture, and motivate personalized support in the development of our teams.

You will have an active role in the firm's growth. Orphoz combines the advantages of a "start-up" - light hierarchy, autonomy, freedom of expression, and initiative - and those of a large group - available resources to develop one's projects, logistical support. We plan and deliver change projects together with our clients, helping them capture their full potential. We know what determines the success of large projects and what can ensure lasting implementation success. We combine strategic and operational project management, with strong execution skills and an understanding of the specific demands of each industry.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, or Engineering, with a strong academic record
- 3+ years’ experience in project delivery and project management / PMO implementation, preferably in a consulting environment
- Industry background in Banking, Energy (Oil & Gas, Exploration & Production, Natural Gas), or Telecommunications
- Functional experience with AI-related solutions (e.g., analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools) is a plus
- Proven experience in business transformation or business change initiatives, such as capability building, digital transformation, transformation office setup and execution, operational excellence, turnaround execution, finance transformation, or supply chain transformation
- Functional experience with AI-related solutions (e.g., analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools) is highly desirable
- Private-sector industry experience is desirable, including FIG (financial services, insurance) and GEM sectors such as Mining, Industrials, or FMCG
- Strong, pragmatic problem-solving skills
- Ability to thrive in a flexible and agile consulting environment
- Hybrid working model, with flexibility to travel as required
- Native Romanian and fluent English; additional languages such as German and/or Hungarian are preferred

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
At Orphoz, we partner with top organizations to make real, lasting change. We specialize in executing large-scale transformations—whether it’s a restructuring, a turnaround, or a performance improvement. Think of us as combining McKinsey-level strategic insight with hands-on execution. We don’t just advise; we close the gap between strategy and impact, ensuring changes stick and empower people.

As a Delivery Consultant, your role will be to turn strategy into action. You’ll translate organizational goals into clear initiatives, set measurable KPIs, and unlock value across performance areas like EBITDA, cash flow, and operational capabilities. You’ll redesign organizations by implementing new models and systems for lasting impact, and you’ll lead transformations, running Transformation Offices that deliver measurable outcomes. A big part of your role will be mobilizing people—engaging leaders, coaching teams, and building resilience. You’ll also collaborate closely with McKinsey experts, connecting strategy with execution to create tangible results.

You’ll be based in Brussels or Amsterdam, with flexibility to travel up to 80% of the time. Most of your work will be on-site or hybrid from Monday to Thursday, with Fridays dedicated to firm development. You’ll be part of a small, trusted team of 3–5 colleagues, integrated with McKinsey partners, ensuring close collaboration and high-impact results

At Orphoz you’ll be part of a distinct practice focused on turning strategy into results. We stay with our clients until the impact is achieved, working alongside a global community of over 500 transformation professionals, including 250+ across 12 European countries in Orphoz. You’ll benefit from McKinsey’s rigorous standards combined with real-world execution experience. The culture is collaborative, resilient, and results-driven—perfect for those who thrive on challenge and continuous growth.
- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a similar field, backed by a strong academic record
- 2+ years of experience delivering transformation programs
- Experience in value-creation areas like operating-model redesign or procurement excellence is a plus, as are certifications such as Lean/Six Sigma or PMP/Agile.
- Sector experience in Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer, FMCG, or Transport & Logistics is also advantageous.
- Entrepreneurial, resilient, and proactive individuals who thrive under pressure
- Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
- Fluency in Dutch (or Dutch and French) plus English - mandatory

Nachhaltige Veränderung zu bewirken und langfristige Fähigkeiten bei unseren Klienten aufzubauen, ist keine einfache Aufgabe. Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, das Leistung fordert und anerkennt. Du nimmst anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen an, lernst, wenn du stolperst und hast das Durchhaltevermögen, um neue Weg zu gehen.

Von uns kannst du erwarten, dass wir deine Zielstrebigkeit und deine Neugier bestmöglich unterstützen, indem wir dir die Ressourcen, das Mentoring und die Chancen bieten, die es braucht, damit du dich weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Und zwar schneller als du es je für möglich gehalten hast. Deine Kolleg:innen - auf allen Ebenen - unterstützen dich nicht nur bei der Erarbeitung hervorragender Ergebnisse für unsere Klienten, sondern auch bei deiner persönlichen Entwicklung. Tag für Tag erhältst du Unterstützung, Coaching und wertvolle Erfahrungen, die dein Wachstum fördern.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:
- Kontinuierliches Lernen: Bei McKinsey erwarten dich viele strukturierte Programme, die dir dabei helfen, dich in allen für dich relevanten Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln. Freu dich auf ein Umfeld, in dem das Feedback klar, umsetzbar und auf deine Entwicklung ausgerichtet ist und in dem du schnell, viel lernst.
- Deine Stimme zählt: Vom ersten Tag an legen wir Wert auf deine Ideen und Beiträge. Mit deinen innovativen Ideen und praktischen Lösungen hast du einen spürbaren Einfluss. Wir fördern unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn sie sind entscheidend, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
- Globale Gemeinschaft: Mit Kolleg:innen aus über 65 Ländern und mehr als 100 verschiedenen Nationalitäten fördert die Vielfalt unsere Kreativität und hilft uns, die besten Lösungen für unsere Klienten zu finden. Außerdem hast du die Möglichkeit, von außergewöhnlichen Kolleg:innen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen zu lernen.
- Attraktive Benefits: Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt (basierend auf deiner Einstiegsposition) bieten wir ein attraktives Leistungspaket, das zum Beispiel umfassende medizinische Leistungen für dich, dein:e Partner:in und Kinder umfasst.

Bewerbungsfrist: Du kannst dich ganzjährig bei uns bewerben. Alle Bewerbungen sammeln wir bis zum nächsten Stichtag. Dann prüfen wir sie und informieren dich über unsere Entscheidung. Eine Übersicht der kommenden Fristen findest du hier: deadline.mckinsey.de

Benötigte Bewerbungsunterlagen: Lebenslauf, Anschreiben (optional) sowie alle relevanten akademischen und Arbeitszeugnisse, beginnend mit dem Abiturzeugnis
Wir bei Orphoz, a McKinsey Company sind überzeugt, dass langfristige positive Veränderungen in Unternehmen nur mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel, einer bewährten Methodik und der Befähigung der beteiligten Mitarbeiter:innen gelingen kann.

Du setzt nachhaltige Veränderungen bei unseren Klienten um: Industrieübergreifend begleitest du die Identifikation und Durchführung von Transformationsprojekten mit dem Fokus auf Prozess-/ und Organisationsoptimierung und wendest dabei die gängigen Projektmanagementmethoden über alle Projektphasen an.

Du wirst als Berater:in von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen unterstützt, verantwortest aber bereits eigenständig Arbeitspakete in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Klienten. Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung im Team.

Gemeinsam mit dem gesamten Orphoz-PME-Team bringst du dich persönlich, mit deinen eigenen Ideen bei der Entwicklung des Unternehmens mit ein und beteiligst dich dadurch aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologien, Methoden und Beratungsansätze.

Als Expert:innen für Transformationen und Projektmanagement setzen wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Klienten komplexe Transformationen über alle Industrien hinweg um. Wir schaffen Transparenz über den Fortschritt und stellen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Management unserer Klienten die erfolgreiche Umsetzung strategisch entscheidender Projekte sicher. Dazu bauen wir als Coaches bei unseren Klienten Kompetenzen in Projektmanagement und Implementierung auf und befähigen somit die Mitarbeiter:innen, nachhaltig Veränderungen zu leben. Auf veränderte Rahmenbedingungen können wir mit unserer Erfahrung und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit McKinsey flexibel reagieren und so stets die besten Lösungen für unsere Klienten erzielen.

Für unser schnell wachsendes Team suchen wir kontinuierlich und deutschlandweit nach Berater:innen. Dich erwartet ein außergewöhnliches Umfeld mit vielen Möglichkeiten, dich einzubringen, dich zu entwickeln und die Zukunft von Orphoz in Europa mitzugestalten.
#LI-MP
- Du hast dein wirtschafts- oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches/technisches Studium (Universität oder FH) erfolgreich abgeschlossen
- Du konntest bereits zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement oder Transformations-/Changemanagement sammeln
- Du begeisterst dich für Prozessoptimierung, Organisationsdesign und Implementierung und besitzt ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
- Du bist ein kommunikationsstarker Teamplayer mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung und zeigst stets überdurchschnittliches Engagement und zeichnest dich durch deine Hands-on Mentalität aus
- Funktionale Erfahrung mit KI-bezogenen Lösungen (z. B. Analytics, Automatisierung oder KI-gestützten Tools) ist von großem Vorteil
- Du gehst sicher mit MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint, um
- Du bringst eine gewisse Reisebereitschaft und Lust auf die Arbeit beim Klienten vor Ort mit
- Du beherrschst die deutsche und englische Sprache fließend in Wort- und Schriftform

jobs.title: Consultant - Orphoz
jobs.location: Bogota, Colombia; Guatemala City, Guatemala; Lima, Peru; Quito, Ecuador; Santiago, Chile
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will design and implement our clients' transformation plans and execute wide transformation programs such as operational improvements, KPIs implementation, process improvement, etc.

In this role, you will coordinate and follow up on Project Management Office (PMO) tasks. You will spend your time preparing and driving implementation projects and coaching clients. You will also manage project workstreams largely independently and with the support of a project manager. As you gain experience, you will gradually assume responsibility for delivering parts of transformation projects yourself. You will lead less tenured consultants and clients in your project or workstream and successfully hold client meetings and workshops to achieve the project's objectives.

You will also contribute to the development of the firm through participation in internal projects.

You will be based in our Bogota, Guatemala, Quito or Santiago office, as part of Orphoz, where our mission is to carry through the most complex transformation projects for our clients. You will join a team of consultants and transformation execution experts.

At Orphoz, we combine the advantages of a start-up (light hierarchy, autonomy, freedom of expression and initiative) and those of a large group (available resources to develop one’s projects and logistical support).
- Bachelor’s degree with a strong record of academic achievement
- 2+ years of experience in project management, preferably in consulting (e.g., in a Project Management Office (PMO) in the context of transformation projects)
- Driven by creating long-lasting impact, and enjoys working with people to achieve results
- Enjoys the flexibility and agility that is required in a consulting environment
- Fluent level communication skills in English and Spanish (both written and verbally)

jobs.title: Associate - Tech & AI
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will work with C-suite executives to problem-solve on their key issues and provide actionable recommendations leveraging your technology know-how and business sense.

You will play an active role in all aspects of a client project, typically working in teams of 3 to 5 consultants alongside experts and partners of all tenures, including developers, designers, data engineers, agile coaches and others. This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations for client presentations. You’ll also present results to client management and advise on their implementation in collaboration with client team members.

You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. This support includes a partner from your local office assigned to help you guide your career as well as several weeks of formal training. Additionally, you'll receive guidance and support from your local office or practice in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.

You’ll join Tech & AI at McKinsey in our Paris office. This group brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use technology to transform their businesses.

As part of this global team, you'll be working on everything from advanced analytics, agile, cloud, cybersecurity and organisation transformation.

You’ll typically work on projects across all industries and functions and will be fully integrated with the rest of our global firm. You’ll also work with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help our clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences and businesses, both on technology and non-technology topics.

You are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world.
- Master's degree in engineering, science or another technical or related field
- 5+ years of post-university experience in technology- and strategy-related roles in a professional services, blue-chip, industry or start up environment
- Combination of strong strategic and analytical abilities with a passion for technology
- Proven track record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
- Outstanding track record of academic and professional achievements
- Fluent level language skills in both English and French

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Finalta Banking
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will work within a small project team to analyze data, evaluate results, generate actionable insights and recommendations and deliver these to your clients.

You will be liaising with our clients to gather data, conduct research and perform quantitative analysis. You'll be working with our team that covers our banking clients and will have the opportunity to travel to client sites. Our projects typically run for 6 months; therefore, you will become an expert in data and topics.

You’ll work with our Finalta WE (Western Europe) team in London. Building on more than twenty years' experience working with leading banks, Finalta combines benchmark performance data and best-practice knowledge from 350 financial institutions in over 50 countries to generate insights on how to achieve superior performance.

Annual benchmarking provides clients with a unique management tool to objectively assess performance against peers and quantify opportunities for improvement. Our best-practice cases illustrate how to close performance gaps and give clients a roadmap to reach world-class performance while reducing the time, cost, and risk of change.
- Bachelor's or master's degree in finance, banking, data analysis, economics, strategy, with internship experience
- 3+ years of experience in data and financial analysis, banking, financial services, insurance or consultancy
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
- Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
- Ability to manage your time to produce high-quality work to deadlines
- Fluent communication skills, both verbally and in writing, in English

You will work in teams to support private investor clients and their portfolio companies throughout the deal lifecycle including diligence, value creation topics and exit support.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to assess and identify market attractiveness, provide targeted information and specialized financial analysis on potential acquisitions as well as prepare and deliver high-impact communication of your synthesized findings. You will also have the opportunity to work directly with portfolio companies on their value creation agenda, spanning a diverse set of topics as well as be a subject matter expert on topics related to our service to investors. You will be recognized as a valuable resource of experience, information and expertise both inside the firm and by our clients.

You will receive training on how to better structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them as well as synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative method. You will work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act. You will establish trust-based relationships with clients to better-serve their organizations, communicate effectively with all audiences including senior leaders and develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths and personal values.

During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a business analyst on multiple client engagements and work with a number of colleagues and clients in a range of private investor settings across different industry and functional areas and develop significant business experience as well as an investor mindset. You will likely intersect with many elements of our firm’s work including digital, implementation, and tech and analytics capabilities.

Your role differs from McKinsey’s generalist business analyst role in its focus. Your role will focus entirely on serving investor clients and their portfolio companies (though because our clients invest across sectors and types of companies, the role still offers exposure to a wide variety of sectors and functional levers). Private Capital consultants will be staffed full time to client engagements.

You will be based in our Madrid office as part of our Private Capital practice. Our practice is the world’s leading advisor to the Private Capital industry and a high growth area for the firm, working with many of the most significant global and local private investors and their portfolio companies.

You will work in teams and directly with our clients. You will also work with the wider McKinsey network including a range of experts in the firm, from industry and functional experts to data scientists to researchers to software and app designers.

McKinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include a senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals. Additionally, you will have a professional development manager who will manage staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams. When you join McKinsey, you are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world.

- Previous experience in investment bank, private equity or venture capital environment with exposure to transactions and/or working in a private equity or venture capital backed company is a plus

- Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
- Capability to drive an independent workstream in the context of a broader team project
- Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations
- Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
- Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, in Spanish and English

You will combine hands-on payroll transformation and implementation expertise with strong operational leadership, taking complex country payrolls from design and transition through go-live, stabilization, and high-quality steady-state delivery.

You will help build a resilient payroll operating model that reduces manual dependency, strengthens tax and regulatory compliance, improves controls, and delivers accurate and timely pay every cycle.

- 10+ years of progressive payroll experience in a complex multinational or professional-services environment, with substantial hands-on responsibility for both multi-country payroll transformation/implementation and live payroll operations
- Demonstrated experience leading complex payroll implementations or transformations across multiple countries in EEMA and APAC markets; experience transitioning from in-house/SaaS payroll to managed services is highly desirable
- Deep practical knowledge of end-to-end payroll - from inputs and gross-to-net through controls, payments, accounting interfaces, statutory filings, year-end activities and post-payroll compliance - with the ability to identify risks and challenge solution designs
- Proven implementation of leadership across requirements and process design, fit-gap assessment, data migration, payroll configuration, integrations, test strategy, UAT, parallel payroll, cutover, go-live and stabilization. - Strong multi-country payroll operations leadership, including payroll calendar governance, exception management, controls, reconciliations, issue resolution, service quality, business continuity, and employee/payroll query management
- Excellent vendor-management capability with experience governing major payroll providers or managed-services partners through clear SOWs, RACIs, KPIs, SLAs, governance forums, escalation mechanisms and performance improvement plans

- Strong technology orientation and experience working across HRIS, payroll engines and finance systems. jobs.title: Associate - Private Capital
jobs.location: Berlin, Germany; Cologne, Germany; Dusseldorf, Germany; Frankfurt, Germany; Hamburg, Germany; Munich, Germany
jobs.description:
Nachhaltige Veränderung zu bewirken und langfristige Fähigkeiten bei unseren Klienten aufzubauen, ist keine einfache Aufgabe. Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, das Leistung fordert und anerkennt. Du nimmst anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen an, lernst, wenn du stolperst und hast das Durchhaltevermögen, um neue Wege zu gehen.
Von uns kannst du erwarten, dass wir deine Zielstrebigkeit und deine Neugier bestmöglich unterstützen, indem wir dir die Ressourcen, das Mentoring und die Chancen bieten, die es braucht, damit du dich weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Und zwar schneller, als du es je für möglich gehalten hast. Deine Kolleg:innen - auf allen Ebenen - unterstützen dich nicht nur bei der Erarbeitung hervorragender Ergebnisse für unsere Klienten, sondern auch bei deiner persönlichen Entwicklung. Tag für Tag erhältst du Unterstützung, Coaching und wertvolle Erfahrungen, die dein Wachstum fördern.
Was dich bei uns erwartet:
- Kontinuierliches Lernen:  Bei McKinsey erwarten dich viele strukturierte Programme, die dir dabei helfen, dich in allen für dich relevanten Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln. Freu dich auf ein Umfeld, in dem das Feedback klar, umsetzbar und auf deine Entwicklung ausgerichtet ist und in dem du schnell, viel lernst.
- Deine Stimme zählt:  Vom ersten Tag an legen wir Wert auf deine Ideen und Beiträge. Mit deinen innovativen Impulsen und praktischen Lösungsansätzen hast du einen spürbaren Einfluss und unterstützt gleichzeitig die kompromisslose Einhaltung unserer Werte und Richtlinien hinsichtlich Ethik und Integrität. Wir fördern unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn sie sind entscheidend, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
- Globale Gemeinschaft:  Mit Kolleg:innen aus über 65 Ländern und mehr als 100 verschiedenen Nationalitäten fördert die Vielfalt unsere Kreativität und hilft uns, die besten Lösungen für unsere Klienten zu finden. Außerdem hast du die Möglichkeit, von außergewöhnlichen Kolleg:innen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen zu lernen.
- Attraktive Benefits:  Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt (basierend auf deiner Einstiegsposition) bieten wir ein attraktives Leistungspaket, das zum Beispiel umfassende medizinische Leistungen für dich, dein:e Partner:in und Kinder umfasst.
Du arbeitest in Teams aus üblicherweise 3 bis 5 Berater:innen mit ganz unterschiedlichem Background (Finanzen, Medizin oder Naturwissenschaften) und unterstützt Investoren und ihre Portfoliounternehmen über den gesamten Transaktionszyklus hinweg, u.a. bei Due Diligences, zu Wertschöpfungsthemen und bei der Entwicklung von Exit-Strategien. Der Healthcare-Investor-Sektor wächst stetig und ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, dieses wachstumsstarke Geschäftsfeld weiterzuentwickeln und voranzutreiben.

Du beurteilst und identifizierst die Marktattraktivität und unterstützt marktprägende transformative Übernahmen. Neben der transaktionsbezogenen Arbeit hast du die Gelegenheit, direkt mit Portfoliounternehmen an der Ausgestaltung ihrer Wertschöpfungsagenda zusammenzuarbeiten, und bringst Unternehmen, die den Gesundheitssektor künftig prägen und gestalten werden, auf den Weg. Dabei arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unseren Spezialist:innen, u.a. Geschäftsgründer:innen, Designer und Advanced-Analytics-Expert:innen. Du wirst ein wertvolles Mitglied unserer Firma sein, das uns wie auch unseren Klienten seine Erfahrung, Informationen und Expertise bereitstellt.

Als Teil eines schnell wachsenden Teams nimmst du regelmäßig an Schulungen und Weiterentwicklungsprogrammen teil. Du gehörst unserem europäischen Team an, das eng mit unseren Teams in den USA, im Nahen Osten und in Asien zusammenarbeitet. Du entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten in regelmäßigen Trainings weiter, u.a. Strukturierung unklarer Probleme und Ableitung von Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen aus komplexen Informationen anhand qualitativer und quantitativer Methoden. Gemeinsam mit diversen Teams entwickelst du optimale Lösungen, unterstützt Menschen und Organisationen bei ihrer Umsetzung und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen mit Klienten auf, um ihre Unternehmen bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Du kommunizierst effektiv und strukturiert mit allen möglichen Adressaten, u.a. dem oberen Management, verbesserst kontinuierlich deinen Führungsstil und baust auf deiner Passion, deinen Stärken und deinen persönlichen Werten und Überzeugungen auf. McKinsey glaubt an stärkenbasierte Entwicklung und Coaching, du wirst daher regelmäßig von Kolleg:innen gecoacht. Ein erfahrener Mentor oder eine Mentorin aus deinem Büro oder deiner Practice hilft dir bei deiner Weiterentwicklung und beim Erreichen deiner Karriereziele. Ein Professional Development Manager, zuständig für Staffing-Fragen, hilft dir, Projekte zu identifizieren, die deinen eigenen Prioritäten sowie den Bedürfnissen unserer Client Service Teams entsprechen. Wenn du dich für eine Karriere bei McKinsey entscheidest, wirst du Mitglied eines Unternehmens, das gezielt in deine berufliche Weiterentwicklung investiert.

Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf der Beratung von Klienten aus dem Private Capital-Sektor.

Du wirst Mitglied unserer Private Capital Practice sein und einem der Büros angehören, die wir zu unserem deutschen Office zählen (Frankfurt, Düsseldorf, Köln, München, Berlin, Stuttgart, Hamburg, Wien). Du arbeitest in Teams und auch direkt mit unseren Klienten zusammen.

Unsere Practice ist weltweit führend in der Beratung von Klienten aus der Private Capital-Industrie und ein wachstumsstarker Bereich in unserem Unternehmen. Wir arbeiten mit den meisten der großen globalen und lokalen Privatinvestoren und ihren Portfoliounternehmen zusammen. In dieser Rolle unterstützt du unsere Klienten und deren Portfoliounternehmen während des gesamten Transaktionszyklus, begleitest sie bei Transformationen und berätst sie zu Themen mit Wertschöpfungspotenzial (u.a. Strategie, Aufbau digitaler Geschäftsfelder, Commercial Excellence u.v.m.).

Zudem arbeitest du mit dem breiteren McKinsey-Netzwerk zusammen, u.a. mit unternehmensinternen wie auch externen Expert:innen für verschiedene Industrien und Funktionen, Data Scientists, Researchern oder auch Software- und App-Designern.

Bewerbungsfrist: Du kannst dich ganzjährig bei uns bewerben. Alle Bewerbungen sammeln wir bis zum nächsten Stichtag. Dann prüfen wir sie und informieren dich über unsere Entscheidung. Eine Übersicht der kommenden Fristen findest du hier: zeitdichzubewerben.mckinsey.de

Benötigte Bewerbungsunterlagen: Lebenslauf, Anschreiben (optional) sowie alle relevanten akademischen und Arbeitszeugnisse, beginnend mit dem Abiturzeugnis
- Du verfügst über mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung aus einer Investmentbank oder einem Private-Equity-Unternehmen
- Du hast dein Studium mit überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg abgeschlossen und bringst idealerweise eine akademische Zweitqualifikation mit
- Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
- Du bringst sowohl hohe Einsatzbereitschaft als auch ausgeprägte Kreativität mit und arbeitest selbstständig ebenso gut wie im Team
- Du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf, bist kontaktfreudig und reist gern
- Du kommunizierst überzeugend in Wort und Schrift – sowohl in deutscher als auch in englischer Sprache

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

- Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
As an associate, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.

Your clients aren’t just any clients - they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. We’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.

You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter.

As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in STEM; an outstanding academic record is a plus
- Strong expertise in chemical and energy sectors, including chemical processes, production technologies, electric power, natural gas, and energy transition, with experience in consulting or industry roles; knowledge of sustainability, decarbonization practices, innovation trends, market structures, regulatory frameworks, and proficiency in operations, supply chain, strategy, and energy systems analysis
- Exceptional problem-solving skills, including logical reasoning, creative thinking, comfort with numbers, and the ability to untangle complex issues
- Proven leadership experience in professional settings and/or through extracurricular activities
- Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with people at all levels of an organization
- Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing; proficiency in English and Arabic is a plus

jobs.title: Consultant - Orphoz (w/m/d)
jobs.location: Berlin, Germany; Cologne, Germany; Dusseldorf, Germany; Frankfurt, Germany; Hamburg, Germany; Munich, Germany
jobs.description:
Nachhaltige Veränderung zu bewirken und langfristige Fähigkeiten bei unseren Klienten aufzubauen, ist keine einfache Aufgabe. Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, das Leistung fordert und anerkennt. Du nimmst anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen an, lernst, wenn du stolperst und hast das Durchhaltevermögen, um neue Weg zu gehen.
Von uns kannst du erwarten, dass wir deine Zielstrebigkeit und deine Neugier bestmöglich unterstützen, indem wir dir die Ressourcen, das Mentoring und die Chancen bieten, die es braucht, damit du dich weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Und zwar schneller als du es je für möglich gehalten hast. Deine Kolleg:innen - auf allen Ebenen - unterstützen dich nicht nur bei der Erarbeitung hervorragender Ergebnisse für unsere Klienten, sondern auch bei deiner persönlichen Entwicklung. Tag für Tag erhältst du Unterstützung, Coaching und wertvolle Erfahrungen, die dein Wachstum fördern.
Was dich bei uns erwartet:
- Kontinuierliches Lernen:  Bei McKinsey erwarten dich viele strukturierte Programme, die dir dabei helfen, dich in allen für dich relevanten Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln. Freu dich auf ein Umfeld, in dem das Feedback klar, umsetzbar und auf deine Entwicklung ausgerichtet ist und in dem du schnell, viel lernst.
- Deine Stimme zählt:  Vom ersten Tag an legen wir Wert auf deine Ideen und Beiträge. Mit deinen innovativen Impulsen und praktischen Lösungenansätzen hast du einen spürbaren Einfluss und unterstützt gleichzeitig die kompromisslose Einhaltung unserer Werte und Richtlinien hinsichtlich Ethik und Integrität. Wir fördern unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn sie sind entscheidend, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

jobs.title: Senior Client Success Analyst - Wave
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you’ll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:
- Continuous learning : Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters : From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community : With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits : On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will support clients through the full client journey—from early client development conversations through onboarding, adoption, and long-term partnership, helping ensure clients get the most value from Wave, McKinsey's leading GenAI-powered asset, at every stage.

Your work will support activities across client development, operations, and advisory, partnering cross-functionally with colleagues who bring complementary expertise; together identifying and shaping new opportunities, communicating the value of Wave to senior decision-makers, and helping carry those relationships through delivery and beyond. A central part of your responsibilities is helping articulate the value of Wave to clients. You will help demonstrate how Wave (including its GenAI capabilities) helps clients realize measurable value across a range of use cases, from broad-ranging transformations to continuous improvement, operations, and sector-specific applications, supporting the development of a clear business case for senior client leaders.

Across the lifecycle, your work could include: supporting client service teams and cross-functional colleagues in identifying and pursuing new opportunities, helping demonstrate Wave's impact to prospective and existing clients, leading onboarding, training, communications, and adoption strategies, adapting as client needs evolve, building and sustain meaningful relationships with a portfolio of clients and internal teams, surfacing new use cases and growth opportunities along the way, preparing and delivering client activities—workshops, business reviews, product demonstrations, and outreach—articulating Wave's capabilities in the context of what matters most to each client, acting as a client advocate, surfacing client needs and helping resolve issues quickly within the team and across the broader firm, contributing to thought leadership by staying current on client needs, industry trends, and the competitor landscape, and by sharing insight back into product, marketing, and operational improvements or support contract renewals, expansions, and fee discussions, serving as a reliable point of contact across the relationship.

This is high-performance work that is genuinely rewarding, and you'll have a team around you the whole way.

Wave is part of the McKinsey Transformation Practice. You'll be based in Tokyo and work with colleagues across the APAC region, enabling large-scale transformation and change programs through Wave, in combination with other tech-enabled assets.

McKinsey Transformation (MT) is a practice that delivers a proven approach for transformational change to clients seeking radical and sustainable performance improvement. Over the last several years, we have worked with hundreds of organizations around the world and across sectors. Most of our clients are driven by a desire to capture untapped potential; others face significant external challenges or industry discontinuities.

Large-scale change and transformation programs often finish without achieving the expected impact. Organizations lack transparency around goals, they are unable to monitor program status, and their employees can’t see the contributions of their day-to-day work. Wave is McKinsey's proprietary solution that combines a program management digital platform with expert services to help organizations drive sustainable impact, not just activities. Our web-based platform (founded in 2011) acts as a single source of truth for tracking each transformation initiative and KPI, allowing teams to collaborate and act on real-time insights.

You'll work with a variety of colleagues (consulting, product development, service delivery, management, client development). They will be based in Japan as well as different offices across Asia, Europe, and the US. They all have a common passion for digital innovation and smart business processes. You will also have significant interaction with McKinsey consulting teams and client end users across a large portfolio of clients. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with the Wave global product, leadership and client service teams in contributing to overall improvement and growth initiatives.
- Undergraduate degree with an excellent academic record
- 3+ years of experience in client success, account management, client service, or pre-sales in a consultative product or services environment; prior consulting experience desirable but not required
- Experience with SaaS, CRM, and/or digital products preferred; exposure to project, program, or change management desirable
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI and GenAI, with the ability—or a strong interest in developing the ability—to translate AI-enabled product capabilities into clear business value for stakeholders
- Proven relationship management skills; able to build and manage relationships with key stakeholders at multiple levels, both internally and with clients
- Very strong problem-solving skills
- Entrepreneurial drive and sense of ownership, with an interest in contributing to building McKinsey's Wave solution and pipeline
- Commitment to delivering exceptional results
- Willingness to travel 20–30% of the time
- Fluent level language skills in Japanese and an excellent command of English, with clear oral and written communication skills to present value propositions to senior client stakeholders

Commodity Analytics helps commodity producers, processors, buyers, and traders across agriculture/softs, metals, energy, and consumer sectors improve commodity price risk capabilities with cutting-edge data science.

The Commodity Trading Service Line at McKinsey supports clients in commodity trading and risk strategy, trading operations transformation, and trading and risk digitization driven by deep trading experts with hands-on trading experience and advanced analytics assets.

Our Risk Practice supports clients in many different industries facing challenges of developing and implementing tailored concepts for risk. #LI-MP

- 2+ years’ experience in physical/cash markets of metals, power/electricity markets, natural gas, crude oil, refined products, and/or ocean freight
- 2+ years’ experience applying time series analysis of mean-reverting and cointegrated commodity prices/premiums (e.g., ARIMA, VECM, GARCH), supervised learning (e.g., SVM, LSTM, parallel or sequential tree-based models), unsupervised learning (e.g., PCA, K-means clustering), optimization (e.g., LP/MILP and stochastic models), and/or NLP sentiment analysis

- Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- Exceptional benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will coordinate key HR elements within/ across the lifecycle for colleagues, ensure compliance with all legal requirements, maintain local HR processes, support exceptional risk management serving as a key point of contact to counsel colleagues on a broad range of HR policies and guidelines.

You will be the primary point of contact for people actively in the mobility process or who have questions about mobility for your geographic location and will be the process leader, coordinator of services and problem solver for all mobility cases inbound and outbound.

You will independently manage efforts such as: onboarding and offboarding; HR event ownership and administration of programs as appropriate; benefits administration and communication; ad-hoc, weekly, and annual personnel analysis and rep letter; development processes such as evaluation, performance management, capability building; communication and interpretation of policies and procedures, as well as risk management efforts, protecting the firm and firm members from risk.

You will actively build expertise in areas such as People Central and other HR systems; and develop specific expertise in other HR processes across life cycle, proactively identifying issues and proposing solutions and other duty of care programs and HR projects to support office/firm priorities (e.g. Mind Matters, workplace safety, Got a Concern), contributing to efforts beyond immediate scope as needed.

You will communicate the firm’s mobility philosophy and policy to transferees. You will coordinate with the various teams involved in mobility transfers (i.e. international transfer tax, office staffing coordinators, office mobility coordinators, etc.). You will counsel transferees on the most efficient way to use the resources available to them. You will develop/coordinate the development of location-specific and office-specific materials and programs to ease the integration of the expatriate and their family into their new environment. You will manage the inbound and outbound transfer process including managing/coordinating the move approval process, immigration, personal and family needs, language lessons, housing assistance, etc.

You will manage external immigration vendors. You will provide & coordinate ongoing support to transferees and their families with acculturation and integration in the new office, including welcome and departure activities. You will provide & coordinate re-integration of returning transferees. You will coordinate/monitor and ensure the timely payment of mobility allowances and compensation. You will determine and track local cost levels for expense items included in lump sum model. You will keep informed of mobility trends and best firm practices.

Your work will help colleagues as you will be a trusted source of information and counsellor and play a front-line role in answering HR questions and escalate issues as needed.

You will work in Jakarta, Indonesia, as part of our ASO People Function team, reporting to the HR Manager.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
- +3 years of HR experience
- Understanding of local labor considerations and Indonesia immigration regulations and processes (e.g. Indonesia Work Permit and EITAS)
- Knowledge of immigration regulation of Southeast Asia would be an advantage
- Exposure to HR systems (e.g. SAP), advanced level of proficiency in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access and web-based applications and ability to quickly learn new applications/productivity tools
- Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact with a diverse range of people in a fair and consistent manner
- Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail
- Customer service oriented and able to handle competing demands
- Strong problem-solving skills; ability to manage ambiguity with an open mind and positive attitude
- Evidence of sound judgment, professionalism, maturity, trustworthiness and initiative
- Strong communication skills, both written and oral, in both English and Bahasa

jobs.title: Manager of Software Delivery - Supply Chain Management Connections
jobs.description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you’ll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:
- Continuous learning : Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
- A voice that matters : From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
- Global community : With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
- World-class benefits : On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
Working collaboratively with our clients—often on-site with their engineering groups and management—you will gather and analyze information, formulate and test hypotheses, and define new organizational structures, roles, and processes.

You will join our Madrid office as part of our Manufacturing and Supply Chain (MSC) Solutions group, a component of McKinsey’s Operations practice that focuses on deeply tech-enabling our client service. Supported by a global network of Supply Chain Management (SCM) Connections, you will spend a significant part of your time solving complex, cross-industry client problems in the Supply Chain domain, specializing in digital Supply Chain Planning.

Your key technical responsibility will be to design and deploy solution architectures for chosen technology platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, o9, SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, Anaplan, etc.), facilitating the integration of advanced planning solutions with clients' legacy systems. Beyond third-party software, MSC Solutions comprises an ecosystem of customizable, web-based digital tools that turbocharge McKinsey diagnostics and help clients digitize their production environments. During this process, you will further enhance our open-source technology, allowing groups to capitalize on existing modules and pre-built benchmarking infrastructure.

In our exciting collaborative culture, you will ensure we bring tangible, lasting impact to our clients by developing these tailor-made solutions. Additionally, you will work closely with internal product development teams and colleagues globally to optimize our capabilities, share your expertise, and expand the collective firm's knowledge base regarding supply chain technology—ultimately helping to create new, innovative offerings to deploy to our clients.

In addition to working with 3rd party software providers such as Kinaxis, o9, SAP, Blue Yonder, Anaplan etc., MSC Solutions also comprises an ecosystem of customizable, web-based digital tools that turbocharge McKinsey diagnostics while serving as a platform on which clients can digitize their plants and production environments to improve performance.

You will work directly with our clients and McKinsey colleagues to deploy our digital capabilities and ensure we bring tangible, lasting impact to clients. Our client project teams work with major global organizations across multiple industries to solve their most challenging problems. In most cases, this means working on site, directly with client engineering groups. Additionally, you will work with internal product development teams to ensure we optimize our capabilities and constantly innovate.
- Bachelor’s degree, advanced degree preferred
- 8+ years’ experience in a client-facing consulting role configuring and deploying supply chain planning systems such as Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, etc.
- Experience with agile and scrum methodologies and/or familiarity with common ERP systems (e.g., SAP) preferred
- Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is desirable
- Deep understanding of supply chain planning concepts including Demand Management, Distribution Planning, Master Planning and S&OP
- Good understanding of data requirements for advanced planning systems and the technical requirements for data integration and optimization
- Ability to analyse and process large amounts of data and complement it with intuition to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is key
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
- Strong ability to lead by example and demonstrate proficiency in both product and domain
- Patient listener with the ability clearly articulate your view point to manage and deliver to customer expectations, even under pressure
- Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint for analysis and presentation
- You will be based out of our Madrid office and should be comfortable with extensive travel, up to 80%
